text: I learned stonework from my father.
He taught me that stone remembers pressure.
The palace complex is older than the settled town around it, but not uniform in construction.
Different sections show different tool marks — some from wood-joiners, some from brick-layers, some from stone-dressers.
Some parts were clearly added later, especially the polished stone facings.
Others appear to have been repaired repeatedly over unknown time spans.
Renu believes these differences represent symbolic phases tied to dharma and ritual meaning.
I believe they represent functional repairs, nothing more.
Both interpretations might be partially correct.
The central assembly plaza has shifted slightly over many years, likely from the old timber substructure settling.
Most people do not notice this.
The shift is not dangerous yet.
But it is measurable.
Certain pillars in the complex have been re-dressed or replaced multiple times.
The replacement stone is polished sandstone from Chunar, far upriver — not the local stone used in the oldest work.
That suggests the pillars were quarried, floated down the Ganga, and hauled here at great cost — not simple local repair.
The small ancient shrine near the temple uses timber joinery techniques different from the newer brick-and-stone structures.
It may predate the current masons' known building methods entirely — perhaps from before the palisade city itself.
I have documented tool mark inconsistencies across the palace foundation.
No official record in the granary archives explains these differences.
Vasu maintains ritual integrity of the shrine but does not question its structural origin.
That is not his role.
Chapala once asked about hidden chambers beneath the Great Hall.
I told her there are stress points consistent with hollow spaces below, near the old timber platform.
I did not elaborate.
After the Agnikanda, the Night of Fire, some stone sections shifted slightly.
The shift was minor but noticeable in alignment measurements against the old plumb-marks.
Repairs made after that fire do not fully match the previous structural patterns.
Someone altered construction details during those repairs.
I do not know who.
